name: IDEAM
body: HSTS, a permanent https redirect, dates on its pages, and real 404s for unknown paths. But 12 of the 41 images on the home page, the topic menu icons among them, have no alt attribute, so screen readers may read file names.
lesson: Give each icon alt text that names its link, or alt="" when the link already has visible text.
summary: www.ideam.gov.co scores 74 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 14 pass. Fix first: 1922 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme.

fix.title: 1922 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: ideam.gov.co (1922). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.ideam.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 122 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 18 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 18 indexable pages are missing from the sitemap
fix.fix: Add them to the sitemap or regenerate it on each deploy.

fix.title: 17 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /transparencia (110), /atencion-y-servicios-a-la-ciudadania (116), /participa (72), /sala-de-prensa (77) and 13 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

fix.title: 5 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /sala-de-prensa, /sala-de-prensa/boletines, /sala-de-prensa/informes and 1 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http does not serve the site
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 179 ms
The start page sets a mobile viewport
